import inspect
def transform(g):
    h=len(g); w=len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    rest=[c for c in cnt if c!=bg]
    border=max(rest,key=lambda c:runs(c,g))
    marker=[c for c in rest if c!=border][0]
    bcells=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]==border]
    rs=sorted({i for i,j in bcells}); cs=sorted({j for i,j in bcells})
    def split(v):
        out=[];cur=[v[0]]
        for x in v[1:]:
            if x==cur[-1]+1: cur.append(x)
            else: out.append(cur);cur=[x]
        out.append(cur);return out
    if len(rs)>=len(cs):  # vertical bars, flow horizontal
        top,bot=split(rs)[0],split(rs)[-1]
        cA=sorted(j for i,j in bcells if i in set(top))[0]
        bcols=sorted({j for i,j in bcells if i in set(bot)})
        cB0,cB1=bcols[0],bcols[-1]
        out=[r[:] for r in g]
        for i in range(h):
            for j in range(w):
                if out[i][j]==marker:
                    out[i][j]=4
                    if cB0>j: lo,hi=j+1,cB0-1
                    else: lo,hi=cB1+1,j-1
                    for jj in range(lo,hi+1):
                        if out[i][jj]==bg: out[i][jj]=marker
                    rel=i-bot[0]
                    tr=top[0]+rel
                    if 0<=tr<h:
                        for jj in range(w):
